children: Malaysia's tech sector could face rising derating risks despite a still-intact semiconductor upcycle, Kenanga analysts Cheow Ming Liang and Tan Woon Pin say in a note. Uncertainty over Nvidia's leadership, increased scrutiny of AI funding, tighter U.S. technology restrictions and heightened geopolitical tensions are clouding the sector's outlook, they say. These risks could delay capital spending, weaken order visibility and compress valuations, they warn. Amid the ongoing market correction, the analysts advocate a more defensive and selective strategy, prioritizing earnings resilience and order-book visibility. Frontken Corp. and Kelington remain their sector's preferred exposures. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
